findings.span: The person image is AI-generated and illustrative.
findings.why: A selfie-style card of an AI person reads as a real user or creator showing the product. ASCI's synthetic-content guideline bars fabricated endorsements even when labelled, and a real creator would also need a paid-partnership disclosure (CRE-01).
findings.fix: Replace the AI person with a real, named, consenting creator (with disclosure), or use a pack or application shot instead of a selfie.

tone_read: Calm and plain: it uses the page's own 'heavy cream' and usage words with no emoji, fear or hype, which suits Minimalist more than the casual creator format it borrows from.
language_read: The product name and strength appear exactly in the lockup, and the copy makes no outcome claim. 'Heavy cream' is the page's own wording, though a reviewer may want it softened for a feel-led ad.
